story: The Breakroom is a neighborhood café in Bothell — the kind of place you can come to for a morning coffee and happily stay through a late lunch.
The menu wanders across comfort food: sandwiches and burgers, rice bowls and yakisoba, crispy wings and breakfast plates, plus a long list of bubble tea, shakes, and espresso drinks.
The room is built for hanging around — soft lounge seating, big windows, marble tables, and a counter where the menu screens glow. Bring a laptop, meet a friend, or come with the whole group.
And when you have something to celebrate, we cater and host private and corporate events too. Same kitchen, same care — just a bigger table.

values.title: Made to order.
values.body: Coffee, boba, and plates come together fresh when you order them.

values.title: Comfort, all day.
values.body: From a 9:30 AM latte to an 3 PM rice bowl, we cook food that feels good to eat.

values.title: Boba done right.
values.body: A long list of flavors, real toppings, and pearls cooked through the day.

values.title: Everyone is welcome.
values.body: Solo laptop sessions, big group dinners, and everything in between.
